A [[human]] served as an '''officer''' in the [[First Order]] during its [[Cold War|conflict]] with the [[Resistance]]. The [[First Order officer|officer]] was stationed in the primary fire control room of the [[Command Center]] of [[Starkiller Base]] at the [[time]] of the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]]. When [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]] gave the order to re-charge the [[superweapon]] after the destruction of the [[Hosnian system]], the officer started the process of draining the power of a [[Unidentified star (Starkiller Base)|nearby star]] and confirmed to Hux that the weapon was charging.<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The officer was portrayed by an unnamed extra in the [[2015]] movie {{Film|VII}},<ref name="TFA" /> while the character's single line was performed by [[Catherine Taber]]<ref name="Voices">{{SW|url=news/from-blast-that-x-wing-to-traitor-the-voices-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=From "Blast That X-wing!" to "Traitor!": The Voices of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''|date=2016-01-25|quote=<u>Starkiller Base Control Room:</u> Weapon Technician (responds to Hux): "Yes sir, weapon charging." -- Catherine Taber}}</ref> (in an uncredited role),<ref name="TFA" /> best known for voicing [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}} et al</ref>
